description: TWO bugs, one fixture. (1) FIXED — line-drop: a pure-addition hunk appended at EOF used to make apply_diff_with_difflib_hybrid_forced's global consecutive-duplicate cleanup pass drop one of two byte-identical adjacent source lines (create(card_id="a") x2) ~47 lines upstream, silently. Fixed in patch_apply.py by budgeting dedup removals per line value against the adjacent-duplicate count already present in the ORIGINAL file; the durable unit guard is tests/test_malformed_hunks.py::test_pure_add_eof_preserves_preexisting_adjacent_duplicate (with a negative control proving it fails on the pre-fix code). (2) OPEN — trailing-newline strip: through the FULL pipeline this fixture takes the system-patch success path (nested target under ZIYA_USER_CODEBASE_DIR), which never reaches the difflib-hybrid-forced drop path — so this corpus case does NOT guard bug (1). What it DOES reproduce is a SEPARATE defect: apply_patch_directly (pipeline_manager.py, small-diff skip-dry-run fast path) strips the file's final newline, while raw 'patch -p1' with identical args preserves it. Result here is byte-correct except for the missing trailing newline (109 lines, 3x card_id="a" — line-drop confirmed fixed). Left failing (not expected_to_fail) as a live reproduction of the open trailing-newline-strip bug; see .ziya/BUG-trailing-newline-strip.md.
